name: clientsuccess-mcp
description: MCP server for the ClientSuccess customer success platform. 8 consolidated tools for managing clients, contacts, health scores, interactions, tasks, contracts, renewals, and portfolio intelligence.

cs_password.title: ClientSuccess Password
cs_password.description: Your ClientSuccess password (used to obtain an API access token)

cs_segment_field.title: Segment Field (optional)
cs_segment_field.description: Custom field key used to segment clients into groups (e.g. 'system__cs'). Enables the segment_filter parameter on list/analysis tools.

cs_segment_values.title: Segment Values (optional)
cs_segment_values.description: JSON mapping of segment names to field values. E.g. {"ProductA": "", "ProductB": "productb"}. Empty string means 'field is null/empty'.

cs_renewal_date_field.title: Renewal Date Field (optional)
cs_renewal_date_field.description: Custom field key that holds the client renewal date (e.g. 'Next_Renewal_Date__cs'). Required for the renewals list tool.

tools.name: list_data
tools.description: List/search clients, contacts, interactions, tasks, renewals, and products with filters and concise/detailed modes

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Get full details for a client, contact, interaction, task, contracts, success score, or pulse history by ID

tools.name: create_data
tools.description: Create contacts, tasks, interactions (notes/calls/meetings/emails), or pulse entries

tools.name: update_data
tools.description: Update clients, contacts, tasks, or interactions. Complete tasks.

tools.name: analyze_portfolio
tools.description: Portfolio intelligence: executive summary, health distribution, CSM book, at-risk clients, neglected accounts, churn, missing team tasks

tools.name: analyze_client
tools.description: Client-level analysis: full 360° view with contacts, interactions, contracts, and pulse history

tools.name: lookup_reference
tools.description: Look up statuses, segments, employees, custom field definitions, and interaction types
